subject: HealthGrid MAP — POC environment boarding & final-stage checklist
messages:
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@healthgrid.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09 09:12 -0700
Subject: HealthGrid MAP — POC environment boarding & final-stage checklist

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Attached is a focused MAP workbook (HG_MAP_v2.xlsx) that captures milestone owners and the short list of environment items we need to close the POC in your sandbox: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist entries, and VPC peering. High level ask: can we lock the environment activation window for the week of Aug 17 (target activation Aug 18-19)?

Key checklist items (minimal for handoff):
- Org setup: create HealthGrid org ID in Redwood and invite two pilot users (nina.patel@healthgrid.com, alex.turner@healthgrid.com).
- API keys: request a scoped test token (read/generate) for the evaluation workload; we will emit tokens to your org under the trial policy.
- IP allowlist: provide a single NAT range (CIDR) for your egress or confirm we should provide static egress IPs.
- VPC peering: confirm VPC peer acceptance window; we will provide peering object and route table guidance.
- Acceptance criteria: 1) sample generation throughput at 250 rps, 2) latency median <= 200ms for 512-token requests, 3) model quality pass on your eval set in the MAP sheet.

Please review the MAP workbook and confirm: (a) network contact for peering (name + email), (b) desired activation date (we proposed Aug 18), and (c) whether procurement prefers a single SOW or separate trial addendum. I copied Jordan + Ben to own infra and pricing coordination.

Thanks — I’m aiming to lock timeline by EOD Tuesday so we can reserve Dedicated capacity for your window.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HG_MAP_v2.xlsx, rdinf-trial-terms.pdf
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@healthgrid.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, nina.patel <nina.patel@healthgrid.com>
Date: 2026-08-09 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: HealthGrid MAP — POC environment boarding & final-stage checklist

Thanks Sofia — this looks good and very actionable. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Network contact for peering: Nina Patel (nina.patel@healthgrid.com), she owns infra and will coordinate with our cloud team.
2) IP allowlist: we operate behind a set of NAT gateways; I can provide the egress CIDRs but it's a moving target. Can Redwood instead provide a list of static egress IPs for the trial? That would be cleaner for our firewall rules.
3) VPC peering: we prefer peering with a dedicated RedWood trial VPC rather than shared infra — is that available under the trial?
4) Procurement: we usually like a single SOW with a 30-day trial addendum. I’ll loop procurement on this thread.

Also — quick ask: do you have a short SOC2/Security FAQ we can attach to our internal review?

I’ve looped our procurement alias and Nina; procurement will confirm SOW preferences. Targeting Aug 18 activation is tight but feasible if we can exchange keys and peering details by Aug 12.

Best,
Alex
VP Product, HealthGrid
alex.turner@healthgrid.com

Alex / Sofia —

Short note from infra: we can provision a dedicated trial VPC for HealthGrid (no shared infra). I attached a quick network sketch (network-sketch.png) with the NAT egress option and the static IP block we can reserve for the trial (10.141.12.64/28 mapped to our egress NATs). If HealthGrid wants to use that, we will push the allowlist on our side and share the peering template (CloudFormation / Terraform).

Action owners: Jordan -> create trial VPC + peering template by Aug 12; Ben -> issue scoped API keys once org is created; Sofia -> coordinate acceptance tests and runbook.

We will also attach a short Security FAQ and SOC2 overview to the MAP workbook before we send to procurement.

—Jordan

Thanks all — quick update and next steps (finalizing timeline):

- Trial VPC: Jordan has confirmed dedicated VPC. Jordan: please send CloudFormation and the peering acceptance template by COB Aug 12.
- API keys: Ben will issue a scoped test token (expires in 30d) to HealthGrid org once Nina confirms org ID. Ben: target issuance Aug 13.
- IP allowlist: we will reserve the static egress block Jordan mentioned. Alex/Nina: if you prefer to provide your NAT CIDR instead, send it by EOD Aug 11 (we received nothing, using ours).
- Security docs: attached a short security FAQ and the trial terms (rdinf-trial-terms.pdf).
- DocuSign: procurement, I’ve initiated a DocuSign envelope for the single-SOW + 30d addendum — link: https://www.docusign.com/Signing/?s=0A1B2C3D. Michael, please sign and route back.

Proposed activation window: Aug 18 08:00 UTC — Aug 19 20:00 UTC. Acceptance runbook and eval prompt set are in the MAP workbook; Sofia will coordinate an acceptance run on Aug 20 with HealthGrid QA to verify throughput and quality signals.

Next meeting: 30-min sync on Aug 13 to confirm peering status and token issuance.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

—Sofia
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
